items.title: Introducing Wiz ADR: Strengthening Cloud and AI Detection and Response with Application Context
items.description: See which functions in your code triggered a runtime alert, use agentic investigation to cut false positives, and automate response down to the exact file and line to fix.

items.title: A Feast for AI: What Wiz Agents are Thankful For
items.description: Grab a slice of Data Pie and pull up a chair. Here’s how Wiz’s Red, Green, and Blue Agents celebrate a quieter, smarter security season.

items.title: Inside Agentic Offensive Frameworks: Intent IDs
items.description: Intent IDs (iNNNN) from agentic offensive frameworks like ARTEX and Cairn are leaking into victim logs. We break down how these counters work in code, how defenders can use them to pace and deconflict attacker activity, and where the signal breaks down.

items.title: “Do Good Security” and Other Lessons from Wiz’s FedRAMP VDR & VER Event
items.description: Key highlights from government leaders, industry experts, and the Wiz FedRAMP team from our November 12th event on modernizing vulnerability management to meet FedRAMP’s new requirements.

items.title: Powering the OpenAI Daybreak Defense Factory with Wiz Security Intelligence
items.description: Bringing cloud security intelligence to AI-driven vulnerability investigation and code remediation.

items.title: Agentic Attacks: In The Wild
items.description: Agentic offensive frameworks like ARTEX are driving a surge in cloud intrusions. Wiz Research shares cases from the wild, including both sides of one attack via the operator's leaked logs, an update on Black October, and the detections that catch these noisy, machine-speed attacks.

items.title: phpAfterShell and Critical PHP RCE Vulnerabilities: Everything You Need To Know
items.description: Detect and mitigate phpAfterShell, and additional critical vulnerabilities from PHP's November release that may enable remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in NGINX: CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007
items.description: Two critical HTTP/2 flaws can allow attackers to compromise NGINX servers, putting the websites, APIs, and sensitive data they handle at risk.

items.title: CVE-2026-114938 OpenJDK RCE (Java4Shell): Everything You Need to Know
items.description: Detect and mitigate Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938), a critical 9.2 RCE vulnerability affecting OpenJDK and major Java-based applications.

items.title: Microsoft agent-framework Compromised: Credential Stealer Targets Azure and CI Pipelines
items.description: On November 17, 2026 at 20:35 UTC, versions 1.26.1 & 1.26.2 of the Microsoft PyPI package agent-framework were published with an added credential stealer. The package gets almost 200k downloads a month. The malicious versions have since been quarantined.

items.title: Introducing the Wiz AI Security Agent
items.description: Meet the Wiz AI Security Agent, your newest security teammate to discover AI agents, understand their purpose, and expose hidden risks.

items.title: The Green Agent POV: Formulating the Fix for an Exposed Container with Sensitive Data Access
items.description: See how the Green Agent balanced security urgency with business continuity to turn a toxic combination into an executable remediation plan and ready-to-merge pull requests.

items.title: ASPM in the AI Era Part 3: Fixing Risk at the Speed of Code
items.description: Accelerate MTTR and eliminate remediation bottlenecks with simplified ownership mapping, code fixes, and automated workflows

items.title: Critical RCE Vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server: Everything You Need To Know
items.description: Detect and mitigate CVE-2026-119618, a critical RCE vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server. According to Wiz data, 64% of cloud environments have resources vulnerable to CVE-2026-119618. Immediate patching is advised.

items.title: How to Evaluate AI Agent Cybersecurity Capabilities
items.description: A tutorial for building a benchmark for offensive agents, based on how we built the Wiz Cyber Model Arena

items.title: Wiz and ISMAP: Building the Foundation for Japan's Public Sector
items.description: A transparent look at our gap assessment, our ISO alignment, and our plan to earn a spot on Japan's government cloud service list

items.title: Trusted by Default: Qubole Cross-Account Access Abused in the Wild
items.description: A threat actor used IAM credentials from Qubole's AWS account to assume integration roles in customer AWS environments. Here's what we observed and how to hunt for it.

items.title: The ROI of Agentic Remediation: Real-World Results with Wiz Green Agent
items.description: Learn how Fireblocks, Rogo, and project44 used Green Agent to eliminate cross-team blockers and accelerate critical risk resolution.

items.title: From Reactive to Proactive: Empowering SOC Teams with the Wiz Red and Blue Agents
items.description: Red Agent gives SOC teams validated pre-breach alerts, while Blue Agent investigates active threats at machine speed, helping teams stay ahead in the AI threat era.

items.title: “Black October” for AI Developer Platforms
items.description: A series of agentic attacks on AI Developer Platforms has been leading to LLMJacking at scale.
